Infernis was previously used for the mining of crystals and other various materials. But due to the increase of volcanic activity all sorts of insects infiltrated the facilities to seek refuge. Every employee within the building at this time was either devoured or cooked by the extreme heat.

> Moon Map

Loading scripts


> Moon Info

POPULATION: Deceased.

CONDITIONS: Extremely hot, Dry dusty terrain, Rarely supports living plant life due to recent volcanic activity.

FAUNA: A desperate ecosystem, remaining creatures support agressive behaviour.

> Environment

Infernis has hot and dry terrain with little signs of plantlife beyond red bushes. Several large crystals are scattered across the landscape and a ring of lava surrounds the exterior. Its most prominent landmark is the large volcano that can be seen behind the ship, which periodically shoots out molten rock that crashes onto the exterior. This volcanic activity causes dust to scatter in the interior and reduce visibility. When the ship leaves Infernis, the volcano will erupt and the lava will rise and cover the exterior.

Four square shaped buildings can be found around the exterior, which are the main entrance and fire exits. The main entrance is on the right-hand side of the pathway that is behind and to the left (south) of the ship. A fire exit can similarly be found by going straight from the main entrance and past the floodlight on the ground. Another fire exit can be seen southeast of the ship, but requires a relatively difficult jump, tools like a ladder or TZP, or finding the exit within the interior to push a stalgamite and create a bridge to make the exit accessible. The last and southwest fire exit can be found by going to the path behind the ship and heading left to a short parkour above lava.

Interior Ambience

> Weather

Infernis can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

If Infernis experiences Rainy weather, steam will be present on the exterior and can reduce visibility.

If Infernis experiences Stormy weather, the lava and lava crystals on the exterior will be blue. This is just a visual change.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Music

Infernis has a unique music track that plays after landing on the moon.

Lava

The lava on the exterior acts like quicksand and rapidly deals 10 damage per hit. If players fall into the holes with lava at the bottom, they will instead take 20 damage per hit.

Major Story Spoilers: Falling Debris

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto the exterior of Infernis near the path behind and to the left (south) of the ship. If players land on Infernis in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the Infernis videotape found on Galetry into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Atlantica: Head straight behind the ship and turn right at the first crystal. A map will be on the ground further down the path between three crystals. Interacting with this will cause a voice to start speaking before unlocking Atlantica.
Acidir: Log Cunningham's travel log 1 found on the exterior by following the floodlights south to a camp.
Dreck: Log Floppy disk that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Gratar: Gratar videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Oldred: Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Burnt Note 1

Image & Text ⁠
The volcano was supposed to be dead!
At least that's what they told us.
Any poor soul out there is currently being fried in the fiery rains of death.
If we don't call in rescue..
We might not see the light of day again.

Burnt Note 2

Image & Text ⁠
We were able to reach out to one of those giant emergency service centers on Polarus.
One of those near the overly protected vaults.
I wonder what kind of crazy stuff they hide in there.
Anyway, rescue is on the way. We're scared but only a few more hours and we will be safe.

Burnt Note 3

Image & Text ⁠
We heard noises in the walls.
A buddy of mine went to investigate one of the vents and..
There were so many of them..
The bees they..
I can still hear his screams as they were digging into his eyesockets and flying into his mouth.
If rescue won't come quick, I don't know what else might follow.

Burnt Note 4

Image & Text ⁠
They're everywhere!
Bees, spiders and whatever else lived out there.
I think they killed most of the people here.
I'm heading out the fire exit to wait outside.
It's that or getting eaten alive in here..
Tell my family I love them.

Map of Atlantica

Head straight behind the ship and turn right at the first crystal. A map of Atlantica will be on the ground further down the path between three crystals. Interacting with this map will cause a voice to start speaking and unlock the moon afterward.

Image & Text ⁠
From the bay through the temples, across the porcelain bridges, the sinking city awaits.

Infernis Videotape

This videotape will always spawn within the museum of Galetry.

Text ⁠
Tape 1, Infernis.

This is Captain Commander Cunningham.
I have decided to start recording our sites of research and the environments we find ourselves in.

Our current location is Infernis.
This fiery hellscape has done nothing but slow us down.
The seismic activity here is quite high so I'm not expecting to stay long.
Good thing.
The mineshafts are riddled with bugs and are very much preventing us from doing anything.

I rate this place a B+.
Cunningham, signing off.
